Scope: Current official publisher-page and retained-pin follow-up for NTCore 4GB Patch; no executable or target image execution/modification

Claims: Patches x86 executables to set the large-address-aware flag so that 32-bit applications can use up to 4 GB of virtual address space on x64 Windows
Can be used through a file-selection GUI or command line with an executable path
Automatically creates a backup copy of the original executable
NotSpecified: Whether original signature, checksum or other executable metadata is preserved
Exact supported Windows builds or behavior when the flag is already set

RelatedPublisherDocumentation.Observation: A separate CFF Explorer script example implements the same PE flag change by OR-ing IMAGE_FILE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE into the PE file-header Characteristics field and offers overwrite or Save As. This is documentation for CFF scripting, not a license grant for 4GB Patch.

LicenseDisposition: No explicit product-specific use or redistribution grant was located in the reviewed product page or retained single-file archive evidence. Copyright metadata is not permission. Do not admit or distribute pending applicable publisher terms.
AcceptanceBoundary: Any later functional check must use a synthetic owned x86 PE, preserve a separately hashed original, verify exact output flag and backup path/content, and prove exact recovery. Do not patch third-party or production executables.
EstimateReason: The publisher behavior and automatic backup claim are clearer, but backup semantics, product-specific rights and native recovery remain unresolved; no whole legacy outcome closes and ranges remain unchanged.
